description: Land Acquisition - Gonnoruwa, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land lots being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains descriptions of land parcels, their locations, extents, and current use (e.g., chena cultivation, waste land, roads), which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters.
